caption: The drawing depicts the upper half of a nude female figure with long, wavy, dark brown hair that falls over her shoulders. Her skin is a light tan color, and her facial features are finely detailed with visible eyebrows, eyes, nose, and lips. The figure is shown from the waist up, with both arms extended outward and bent at the elbows, holding a garland. The garland is composed of various multicolored fruits and flowers, including objects in shades of red, green, orange, purple, and yellow. The garland is held at both ends by the woman's hands, which are positioned near the lower corners of the image. The background is plain and an off-white or beige color, with no additional objects or scenery present. The overall composition centers the female figure and the decorative garland horizontally across the drawing.
title: Stern Piece
